query:
SELECT q.id, q.claim_id, pb.name as panel_beater_name, pb.business_name,
       q.quoted_amount, q.status, q.created_at,
       COUNT(qli.id) as line_item_count
FROM panel_beater_quotes q
LEFT JOIN panel_beaters pb ON pb.id = q.panel_beater_id
LEFT JOIN quote_line_items qli ON qli.quote_id = q.id
GROUP BY q.id, q.claim_id, pb.name, pb.business_name, q.quoted_amount, q.status, q.created_at
ORDER BY q.created_at DESC
LIMIT 20;
